name: matrix_m1_stage1
description: Stage 1 additions on the existing matrix_m1 adapters (no training): full cross-target questions at blocks 5 and 20, open-book questions for IT at block 5 and the parents, and development-question answers for judge calibration.
off_target_note: Each intervention model answers every other target's 200 questions at the cross-target blocks, so each target has three off-target controls per seed and regime.
deviations_from_design: learning rate 1e-4 instead of 1e-5 (docs/PILOT_DECISIONS.md), chosen after the design setting produced no measurable learning; see runs/paper1/gate_lr1e-4/
familiarization uses 5 passes over the 400 items instead of 1
exact paired token budgets are not enforced; per-block token totals are recorded
generation and judging cover blocks 1, 5, 10 and 20 in this round, declared before any matrix result; adapters for all 20 blocks are saved
cross-target control added: off-target intervention models answer each target's questions at blocks 5 and 20
judge is one uncalibrated Haiku 5.5 reader per response, not the protocol's calibrated judge
stage 1: open-book question variant (candidate facts shown) added as an exploratory test; development questions generated for judge calibration
